name: Clarification answer completes a direct edit

turns.prompt: Move Saturday’s run to 7. Keep its duration. Prepare it.
turns.text: Do you mean AM or PM for that start time? I will leave the calendar unchanged until the time is clear.

turns.prompt: 7 PM please, same Saturday and same 60 minutes.

proposal.impact: Saturday’s long easy run moves later the same day, with the same 60-minute relaxed duration. All other sessions stay unchanged.
